name: TRACTA
description: TRACTA (Temporal Reasoning and Capability-Trajectory Analysis) is a controlled synthetic benchmark and reproducibility package for evaluating temporal reasoning over semantic trajectories in structured dynamic systems. The frozen benchmark comprises 200 synthetic event runs—100 positive and 100 negative—with a 96-step temporal horizon. It provides raw-event representations, capability trajectories, contextual direct-impact trajectories, structural annotations, and a fixed family-balanced train/validation/test split of 140/30/30 runs. The benchmark supports three task families: early warning at lead times of 3, 6, and 12 steps; pattern detection; and run classification. This record contains three coordinated archives: tracta_v1_0_0_benchmark_construction.tar.gz provides the operative canonical event log, family and semantic specifications, benchmark-construction configuration, paired run generator, accepted synthetic runs and ontology instances, validation records, and construction manifests. tracta_v1_0_0_benchmark_release.tar.gz provides the frozen benchmark datasets and split, reference resources, model and evaluation code, experimental configurations, execution scripts, tests, and reproducibility documentation.
